name: prodpilot
description: AI Content Automation Platform untuk Multi-Brand

scripts.stack:up: brew services start postgresql@17 && brew services start redis
scripts.stack:down: brew services stop postgresql@17 && brew services stop redis
scripts.build: npm run build -w @prodpilot/api && npm run build -w @prodpilot/web
scripts.gen:api: npm run gen:openapi -w @prodpilot/api && npx openapi-typescript apps/api/openapi.json -o apps/web/lib/api.gen.ts
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:generate -w @prodpilot/api && npm run prisma:migrate -w @prodpilot/api && npm run db:seed -w @prodpilot/api
